name: Axiom
headline: Master Your Workflow
tagline: Organize your day. Achieve more. Tasks, alarms and notes with AI capture, Kanban, Gantt and calendar views.
description: Axiom is an all-in-one productivity app. Type or say what you need and the AI files it as a task, an alarm or a quick note — then plan it on a list, a Kanban board, a Gantt timeline or the calendar, and follow your progress on the dashboard.

features.title: AI Input
features.text: Type or speak: the AI decides whether it is a task, an alarm or a quick note and fills in the date, time and subtasks.

features.title: Kanban Boards
features.text: Move tasks through Backlog, To Do, In Progress and Completed at a glance.

features.title: Gantt Charts
features.text: See your plan on a visual timeline with progress bars.

features.title: Calendar
features.text: See tasks by day and reschedule them with a long press.

features.title: Alarms & Reminders
features.text: Recurring tasks and exact alarms that ring at the time you set.

features.title: Progress Dashboard
features.text: Completion rate, weekly trend and streaks to keep your momentum.

highlights: Export to CSV, Excel, PDF or JSON

legal.purpose: organizing tasks, alarms and notes, and turning what you type or say into tasks

dataCards.title: Your tasks and projects
dataCards.text: The tasks, subtasks, alarms, notes and settings you create are stored on your device. We do not upload them to our servers, and local backups stay on your device.

dataCards.title: Voice input
dataCards.text: When you dictate, your device's speech recognition service (for example, Google on Android) turns your voice into text. Axiom does not record or keep audio; the text is then handled like typed text.
